rapport_notes: Thorough and patient answering a first-time customer's many process questions (cancellation, online booking, timing) on a small home-office move.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any special instructions, concerns or stressors about moving in general... as of this time?" - asked after the full item and address intake.

top_strength: Explicitly asked to lock the booking ("do you want me to go ahead and book you in for Sunday already?") rather than leaving it open-ended.
coaching_note: Estimate stayed at the flat minimum with no personalized time range - same gap as other small/minimum-hour jobs; worth a short version of the anchor pitch even here.
